result.description: Compact 8-port Power over Ethernet network switch designed for small office deployments, security cameras, and smart building accessories. Features automatic device detection, silent fanless operation, and a rugged metal enclosure for desktop or wall-mount use. Includes VLAN support, basic QoS, and gigabit uplink connectivity for stable wired networking.
